title: The Numbers Nobody Checked
subtitle: 数据统计 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）
meta: 主题语境：数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）　|　核心词汇：quality　|　正文 373 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 quality 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: The first job I was ever trusted with was checking a survey, and the first thing I learned is that the ① quality of a number has very little to do with the number. Quality, in this business, is mostly a matter of who was asked. Six hundred people had answered; a hundred and forty of them had answered the same way to every question, and the ② quality of those answers was zero even though they were all perfectly typed.

My manager, Dr Shah, had one rule. Before you look at what the data says, she said, look at the ③ quality of the data: who answered, when, how long they took, and whether anybody was paid. It sounds obvious, and it is the mark of ④ quality in a report — which most reports do not have. I have since read a great many confident conclusions built on forty-one replies collected in one afternoon.

The survey was about sleep, and we had ⑤ quality data: six hundred households, four weeks, two checks a day. What the results showed surprised us: people reported sleeping seven hours when their phones recorded six, and the gap was larger on weekdays. We spent a fortnight on what statisticians call data ⑥ quality control, which in practice meant telephoning forty households and asking whether they had been guessing. Most of them had.

What the numbers could show, and did, was a ⑦ quality of the town I had not expected: the later a street's lights went off, the worse everybody in it slept. That is not a medical finding, only a correlation, and Dr Shah was careful about the difference. She was also careful about the ⑧ quality of her own caution, which she said could become an excuse for saying nothing at all.

The report came out in June and changed one thing: the council moved a bus route. ⑨ Quality of life, the press release said, had improved by four per cent, which nobody could have measured and everybody printed without asking about quality. I learned then what I have re-learned since: the ⑩ quality that matters in this work is not cleverness, and it is not caution either. It is the willingness to telephone forty households and be told that you were wrong.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 质量；优劣程度
B. n. 优质；上乘（强调好）
C. n. 特性；特质；品质（常用复数 qualities）
D. adj. 优质的；上乘的（作定语）
E. n. 品德；品格（道德层面）
F. 固定搭配：data quality control 数据质量控制
G. 固定搭配：quality of life 生活质量
H. n. （数据的）可信度；可靠性

items.q: the quality of those answers was zero
look at the quality of the data
the mark of quality in a report
was a quality of the town I had not expected
the quality of her own caution
the quality that matters in this work

answers.why: 指数字的“可信度、可靠性”，说数字大小与其是否可信关系不大。
指答案的“质量、优劣程度”，全部选同一项，故质量为零。
指数据本身的“质量”，故后文追问谁答的、何时答的。
the mark of quality 意为“优质的标志”，quality 作名词表“优质、上乘”。
quality 作定语形容词，意为“优质的”，指这批睡眠数据质量上乘。
data quality control 是固定术语，意为“数据质量控制”。
指小镇的一种“特性、特质”，即路灯熄得越晚睡得越差。
指她那份谨慎本身的“性质、特质”，说它可能变成什么都不说的借口。
quality of life 是固定搭配，意为“生活质量”。
指从业者真正要紧的“品格”，即肯打电话去核实、肯认错。
